title: Mary Ann Munce
clean_html:
Mary Ann Munce

Preserved Primary Document • munce-m3.htm

Mary Ann "Polly" Munce, the daughter of Isaiah Munce and Elmira Carty was born in Kent Co. Delaware on 1 August, 1859. Sometime before 1889 she married Samuel Seeney who was born in October 1853. They had the following children: Lola Seeney (1878-1963) married J. Thomas Mosley Lola is buried at John Wesley Church in Frederica, DE Sallie Seeney (Sept. 1881- ) married Simon Miller Margaret Seeney (Aug. 1885- 1964 ) married Horace Mosley Margaret is buried at John Wesley Church in Frederica, DE Mason Seeney (March 1888- ) married Lydia Hughes Mamie Seeney (Dec. 1889- ) Walton Seeney (Aug. 1891- 1963) married Julia Loatman and Maybel B. Mosley (1904-1989) Samuel Seeney Elinor Seeney (July 1894- ) Elmira Seeney (1894? -1961) married William Durham (1883- ) both buried at Forest Grove 7th Day Adventist Cemetary I do not know when Polly died. Samuel died in 1935 and is buried at Immanual Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold.
